description: Create house.book, shelved on a piece of furniture and sometimes lent to a friend.
rationale: A book is on a shelf, and a shelf is furniture, so shelf_item_id points at house.furniture rather than at house.item -- a book cannot be shelved on a frying pan. Who borrowed it is the field this household actually needs.

intents.comment: Detail for an item of category book. One row per house.item row.

columns.name: isbn
columns.comment: ISBN-13 with or without hyphens. Null for anything printed before 1970 or bound at home. Unique when present.

columns.name: title
columns.comment: Title as printed on the spine.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Author as printed. One text field on purpose: this is a household shelf, not a library catalogue.

columns.name: shelf_item_id
columns.comment: The piece of furniture it is shelved on. Null when it is in a pile, or lent out.

columns.name: borrowed_by
columns.comment: Name of the friend who has it. Null when the book is home. Renamed to borrowed_by_friend in 0099.

columns.name: borrowed_on
columns.comment: When it left the house. Null when the book is home.

intents.name: book_shelf_item_id_idx
intents.comment: Leads with the referencing column of book_shelf_fk, and answers 'what is on this shelf'.

intents.name: book_borrowed_idx
intents.comment: Partial: the lent-out shortlist. Most books are home, and only the absent ones are ever chased.
